Learning center

Understand rental cash flow

Connect income assumptions to the expenses behind the result.

Begin with collected income

Scheduled rent and collected rent are different. Vacancy changes income. Use an explicit vacancy assumption and compare it with the property’s actual history when available.

Include the expense categories

Separate operating costs from debt payments. Taxes, insurance, maintenance, HOA charges, management, and other operating expenses affect net operating income. Debt payments then affect cash flow.

Keep reserves visible

A positive monthly result does not eliminate future capital expenses. Roofs, major systems, turnover work, and other projects need separate attention. This calculator is a starting point for a property-specific conversation.
